definitions.explanation: A non-religious wedding ceremony in which the couple makes their vows in front of the assembled guests, who serve as the witnesses. Allows free design of the ceremony's content and style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人前式|じんぜんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: The two of them chose a secular wedding.

examples.japanese: {人前式|じんぜんしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{縛|しば}られ→縛る：03925_shibaru⟧ず⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Secular weddings aren't bound by religion and can be staged freely.

examples.japanese: {人前式|じんぜんしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}→招待客：28262_shoutaikyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{証人|しょうにん}→証人：18845_shounin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: At a secular wedding, the invited guests serve as the witnesses to the marriage.

notes:
Literally "ceremony before people": {人前|じんぜん} (before people) + {式|しき} (ceremony). In a {人前式|じんぜんしき}, no clergy officiate — the guests witness the vows. Grew in popularity from the 2000s onward as couples sought more flexible, religion-free formats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人前式|じんぜんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to hold a secular wedding
- {人前式|じんぜんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誓|ちか}い→誓い：14178_chikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: the vows at a secular wedding
- ⟦オリジナル→オリジナル：10829_orijinaru⟧{人前式|じんぜんしき}: an original (custom-designed) secular wedding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{神前式|しんぜんしき}→神前式：28943_shinzenshiki⟧: Shinto wedding
- ⟦{教会式|きょうかいしき}→教会式：28944_kyoukaishiki⟧: church wedding
